question: Where can I get a list of solar PV plants in operation in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: EIA-860 (final 2025) lists 7,979 operating PV generators at 7,309 plants (152,848 MW AC) in 49 states and DC, with plant coordinates, operator (Utility Name) and commercial operation month and year. EIA-860M (September 2026): 8,335 generators, 7,651 plants, 170,562 MW AC, plus Puerto Rico on separate sheets. USGS USPVDB v4.0 (14 April 2026), downloaded from USGS, maps 6,611 ground-mounted facilities of 1 MW or more linked to EIA plant codes. Under 1 MW there is no plant list: EIA gives estimates by state; LBNL's Tracking the Sun covers about 4.0 million systems by ZIP code, with no operator.
main_caveats: Scope: EIA-860 and EIA-860M cover plants of 1 MW or more combined nameplate; 76 PV plants in the annual file have under 1 MW AC of PV (47 list other generators, 29 none). Small-scale PV has no EIA plant list.
Capacity: EIA nameplate is AC; DC at STC is in the solar sheet (198,471 MW DC against 152,848 MW AC). USPVDB threshold is on DC: 52 of 6,611 records have AC under 1 MW, none have DC under 1 MW.

Date: EIA 'Operating Month/Year' is initial commercial operation per generator; the plant date used here is the earliest. LBNL COD for Topaz (2014-10-31) matches the latest generator. USPVDB p_year is not independent of EIA.
Operator: 'Utility Name' is the company responsible for day-to-day operations, not the owner. 'Entity Name' in EIA-860M differs from it for 190 of 8,307 generators in annual plants.
Location: EIA gives a central point of the property; USPVDB v4.0 gives polygons and a representative point (median gap 0.22 km; 213 matched plants above 5 km; maximum 333 km).

Version: USPVDB v4.0 contains 6,611 facilities; 57 do not match any operating PV plant in the 2025 or September 2026 EIA files, and the EIA files hold 1,064 PV plants of 1 MW or more that v4.0 does not map.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA-860 2025, EIA-860M (September 2026), USPVDB v4.0 and LBNL's utility-scale file were downloaded and checked. Under-1 MW PV was not tested at plant level; LBNL's distributed file was described, not downloaded.

attributes.note: EIA plant/generator points; USPVDB v4.0 polygons and points (ground-mounted, 1 MW+); LBNL points above 5 MW AC. Precision not given in numbers.
attributes.gap_note: Under 1 MW: no per-plant location in EIA files; LBNL's public file gives ZIP code only (guide read, file not downloaded). 213 of 6,553 USPVDB v4.0 records matched to EIA lie more than 5 km from the EIA point.

attributes.note: AC nameplate per generator (EIA-860, 860M); DC at STC (EIA solar sheet, USPVDB, LBNL). Basis kept per field. EIA estimates small-scale AC by state.
attributes.gap_note: Under 1 MW, capacity appears only as state estimates (EIA, 63,193 MW AC in August 2026) or as DC per system in LBNL's file (not downloaded). EIA plant scope is 1 MW combined nameplate or more.

attributes.note: 'Utility Name' (EIA-860) is the company running each plant day to day: 2,629 names at 7,309 plants. EIA-860M 'Entity Name' matches it for 97.7% of generators.
attributes.gap_note: No operator for under-1 MW PV. USPVDB and LBNL's utility-scale file have no operator field. The EIA Ownership sheet (owners, separate from operator) lists 1,386 PV plants, 98 with several owners; not used as operator.

attributes.note: Month and year of initial commercial operation per generator (EIA). USPVDB p_year copies EIA; LBNL 'Solar COD' is a full date per project above 5 MW AC.
attributes.gap_note: No per-plant date for under-1 MW PV in EIA; Tracking the Sun has an installation date, sometimes a proxy such as an incentive claim (guide read). Topaz: EIA first generator 04-2013, USPVDB 2014, LBNL COD 2014-10-31.

sources.name: Annual Electric Generator Report, Form EIA-860, final 2025 data
sources.summary: Official plant-level list of utility-scale operating PV (1 MW plant scope). Gives coordinates, operator, AC capacity, DC capacity and commercial operation month and year.
sources.coverage_note: Plants with total generator nameplate of 1 MW or more, PV in 49 states and DC. Small-scale PV under 1 MW is not listed per plant.
caveats: Capacity is AC nameplate; DC is in a separate sheet.
Dates are month and year of commercial operation per generator, not authorisation dates.
Coordinates are a central point of the property, not a boundary.

problems: records_total counts generator rows of the 'Operable' sheet (all technologies); records_for_country counts solar PV generators with status OP.
Sheets begin with a title line; GDAL names the columns Field1 to Field73 at first, and the real header is the third line.
The file reflects status at 31 December 2025. The monthly file (September 2026) gives a later count.

Revision of 2026-11-19: ZIP downloaded again (SHA-256 identical); 7,979 generators, 7,309 plants, 152,847.6 MW AC, 198,470.9 MW DC (one generator without DC), 2,629 Utility Names, 76 plants under 1 MW AC of PV, 15 OA and 5 OS reproduced with a stdlib XLSX reader.

example.example_request: Download https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860/xls/eia8602025.zip and extract it into an empty folder. Open 3_1_Generator_Y2025.xlsx, sheet 'Operable' (header on the third line), and keep Technology = 'Solar Photovoltaic' and Status = 'OP'. Join 2___Plant_Y2025.xlsx, sheet 'Plant', on Plant Code for coordinates.
example.example_result: Topaz Solar Farm (Plant Code 57695), San Luis Obispo County, CA: 5 OP PV generators, 585.9 MW AC (752.1 MW DC), operator 'Topaz Solar Farms LLC', first generator in commercial operation 04-2013, point 35.405556, -120.068611.

The page lists a release dated 23 October 2026 for the September 2026 inventory and a next release on 24 November 2026; the October file URL returned a redirect to the EIA electricity page and no file.

The FeatureServer count query returned 6,611, equal to the CSV.
ScienceBase (doi.org/10.5066/P9IA3TUS and the catalog item) still returned HTTP 403 to this client; the data release page there was not read.

if_unstructured.summary: Under 1 MW there is no official plant list. EIA publishes state estimates (Table 6.2.B: 63,193 MW in August 2026). LBNL's Tracking the Sun public file holds about 4.0 million systems with ZIP code, DC size and installation date but no operator; the file was not downloaded. State interconnection datasets were not checked.

local_terms.meaning: EIA AC nameplate of a generator; for PV, the sum of AC ratings of the array.
Net DC capacity under STC (1000 W/m2, 25 °C); solar sheet only.
Company responsible for the day-to-day operations of the generator (EIA-860 layout).
EIA plant identifier; USPVDB calls it eia_id, EIA-860M calls it Plant ID.
PV systems under 1 MW, typically on rooftops; estimated by EIA, not listed per plant.
USPVDB scope: ground-mounted PV of 1 MW or more (threshold on DC).
Rooftop systems and ground-mounted systems up to 5 MW AC or 7 MW DC, in Tracking the Sun.
